label: Festival or season
summary: Culturally respectful and inclusive festive voice
Clear order cutoffs and holiday delivery schedules
writing_style: Celebratory yet respectful seasonal greetings combined with practical calendar details.
messaging_principles: Celebrate community holidays with inclusive spirit while communicating operational shipping cutoffs accurately.

rules.title: Avoid Guilt-Tripping Holiday Pressure Tactics
rules.description: Seasonal campaigns must celebrate occasions without exploiting emotional guilt or panic.

suggested_replacements.ruin the holidays: ensure your gifts arrive on time
suggested_replacements.your family will hate you: surprise your loved ones with thoughtful selections
suggested_replacements.worst holiday ever if you miss: plan ahead for seamless holiday delivery

rules.do_example: Order by December 18 for guaranteed delivery in time for holiday celebrations.
rules.dont_example: Don't ruin the holidays—order now or your family will hate you!

terminology.notes: Keep seasonal campaign messaging positive and respectful.
